text: 多家中国车企的固态电池研发业务进程正在提速。10月12日，奇瑞汽车有关负责人确认，公司电池事业部的固态电池研发已在稳妥推进中。10月8日，奇瑞汽车集中发布多项2026年固态电池设备采购项目，涵盖固态电池研发、制备、检测等核心环节。不仅是奇瑞汽车，记者采访获悉，比亚迪、上汽集团、东风汽车等国内主流有新能源业务的车企集团近期都在抓紧固态电池的研发工作。（上证报）
text_en: The solid-state battery R&D businesses of multiple Chinese automakers are accelerating. On October 12, a relevant person in charge of Chery Automobile confirmed that the company's Battery Business Unit's solid-state battery R&D is being steadily advanced. On October 8, Chery Automobile intensively released multiple 2026 solid-state battery equipment procurement projects, covering core links such as solid-state battery R&D, preparation, and testing. Not only Chery Automobile, the reporter learned from interviews that BYD, SAIC Motor, Dongfeng Motor, and other mainstream domestic automaker groups with new energy businesses have recently been stepping up solid-state battery R&D work. (Shanghai Securities News)
